mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_instance (task_id, biz_type, biz_id, graph_json, state, biz_args, started_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{graphJson}, 'RUNNING', #{bizArgs}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE task_instance SET state = #{state}, finished_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND state = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE task_instance SET state = 'SUCCESS', finished_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND state = 'RUNNING' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM node_instance n WHERE n.task_id = #{taskId} AND n.state <> 'SUCCESS')

UPDATE task_instance SET state = 'FAILED', finished_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND state = 'RUNNING' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM node_instance n WHERE n.task_id = #{taskId} AND n.state = 'FAILED')
UPDATE task_instance SET state = 'CANCELLED', finished_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND state = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE task_instance SET state = 'RUNNING', finished_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND state = 'FAILED'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM task_instance WHERE state = 'RUNNING' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT #{limit}
